Final state verified — tree clean, nothing modified-but-uncommitted.

## Run 77 / s3-ui-audit — complete

**Result: 0 defects. 0 code changes. 1 docs commit (`9df54f4`). NET zero DB writes.**

All 7 audits ran under real measurement across all 19 routes. Every one came back clean or landed exactly on an item already documented as a deliberate developer decision:

| Audit | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 Icons | 43/43 imports `@heroicons/react/24/outline`, 0 other libs, **0 non-conforming SVG on 19 routes** |
| 2 Buttons | `.auth-btn` identical (36px \| 0/24px \| 13px \| 700) on 7 pages; nav/toolbar uniform |
| 3 Headers | TopBar 56px on all 19 routes; **h1 present and correct on every route** |
| 4 Sidebar | 18 links, 42px / 12px radius / 18px icons, 1 `.is-active` (except documented `/alerts`) |
| 5 Forms | **0 native `<select>`, 0 native date inputs — 6th consecutive run** |
| 6 Spacing | unchanged; fractional values trace to the documented two-spacing-systems root cause |
| 7 Modals | 4 opened, **all compute `modal-scale-in` at 20px radius — Run 75's fix holds** |

**I raised 8 candidates and killed all 8.** The most instructive: `@keyframes spin` looked airtight-missing for `.address-search__spinner` — no `tailwind.config`, zero `animate-spin` usages, only `icon-spin`/`appleSpinStep` in app CSS. It's supplied by **Tailwind's theme**, and I confirmed it survives a production build by grepping `dist/assets/*.css`. Two others were near-perfect replicas of the Run 76 and Run 75 headline bugs (`var(--tc)` inside a border shorthand; an undefined keyframe) — both died because the CSS has **zero JSX consumers**.

**The headline lesson is a harness bug, not an app bug:** a set difference whose "defined" side reads only app source over-reports whenever a vendor stylesheet supplies the name. I ran seven set differences (four brand-new name kinds: props passed vs destructured, `htmlFor` vs `id`, localStorage written vs read, CustomEvent dispatched vs listened) — **all seven clean**, so that vein is exhausted; I've noted untried kinds for the next stage.

Two things worth your attention:
- **Run 75's "no `<h1>` anywhere" ticket is resolved** — I verified the whole `viewRoutes`→`routeToView`→`viewTitles` chain matches 19/19 and read the titles at runtime.
- **Two new developer tickets** (documented, not fixed per the "don't refactor working features" constraint): dead CSS that's a loaded gun (`.lg-storm-row*` references the undefined `--tc`, so reusing it inherits the Run 76 border-deleting failure), and `.address-search__spinner` depending on a vendor keyframe.

New coverage: the public `/contract/:token` pages rendered for the first time in any run (3 tokens, all clean) — though all three are `status=void`, so the **signed/active contract layout remains untested**, and `/estimate/:token` was unreachable because the estimates list response carries no token field.

Two carry-forwards I did **not** do, both out of this stage's read-only charter: the **QA fuzz-residue cleanup is now 5 stages overdue** (~99 estimates, ~85 `123 Test St` drafts) and needs s4, and I left `.qa-r77s3-token.mjs` untracked deliberately because it hardcodes the login password.
